courses.title: Physics Class 12: Electromagnetism & Wave Optics
courses.subject: Physics
courses.description: Master electromagnetic induction, alternating currents, wave nature of light, and interference with conceptual breakdowns and solved problem sets.

lessons.title: 01. Introduction to Magnetic Fields & Biot-Savart Law
lessons.description: Fundamental properties of magnetic vectors, current elements, and magnetic field calculations.

lessons.title: 02. Ampere Circuital Law & Solenoid Fields
lessons.description: Line integral of magnetic flux density, symmetry analysis in solenoids, and toroid calculations.

lessons.title: 03. Electromagnetic Induction & Faraday Laws
lessons.description: Magnetic flux changes, induced EMF, Lenz law application, and eddy current damping.

lessons.title: 04. Wave Optics: Huygens Principle & Wavefronts
lessons.description: Secondary wavelets, derivation of reflection and refraction using wavefront propagation.

courses.title: Chemistry Class 12: Chemical Kinetics & Organic Synthesis
courses.subject: Chemistry
courses.description: In-depth recorded modules covering rate equations, collision theory, reaction mechanisms, and multi-step organic synthesis paths.

lessons.title: 01. Rate of Reaction & Rate Law Determination
lessons.description: Instantaneous versus average reaction rates, differential rate laws, and reaction orders.

lessons.title: 02. Arrhenius Equation & Activation Energy Analysis
lessons.description: Temperature dependence of rate constants, Arrhenius plots, and catalytic energy profiles.

courses.title: Mathematics Class 12: Advanced Calculus & Differential Equations
courses.subject: Mathematics
courses.description: Calculus masterclass covering limits, definite integrals, differential modeling, and graphical curve analysis.

lessons.title: 01. Limits, Continuity & Derivative Foundations
lessons.description: Epsilon-delta definitions, standard limits, and continuity on closed intervals.
